blocks.text:
## Journey Highlights

The first day focuses on Lima and its history: Santo Domingo Convent, the Main Square, the Cathedral and the collections of the Larco Museum. In the Andes, the route leads through Cusco and the Sacred Valley, where Inca towns, temples and terraces survive alongside traditional weaving practices.

A special day is devoted to visiting Machu Picchu aboard the Hiram Bingham train. The classic carriages, elegant dining car, brunch and gourmet dinner are part of this luxury rail experience. After a guided tour of the Inca citadel, enjoy tea at the Sanctuary Lodge before returning to Cusco on the Hiram Bingham.
